span.label: mechanisms
span.term: overlap-tile prediction with mirrored extrapolation at the border: the missing context outside the image is manufactured by reflecting the image itself, so a tile can be segmented without the network ever seeing beyond the edge
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the paper's claim that this teaches invariance WITHOUT annotating the transformations is made in the introduction, not in this span; tagged separately or not at all
span.term: elastic deformation of the training images, generated from random displacement vectors on a coarse 3 by 3 grid, sampled from a Gaussian with 10 pixels standard deviation and interpolated to per-pixel displacements with bicubic interpolation
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the size of that weight - w0 = 10 - is stated in a different sentence and is not claimed here
span.term: a per-pixel loss weight, pre-computed from each ground truth segmentation by morphological operations, that both compensates class frequency and forces the network to learn the small separation borders introduced between touching cells
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: a large number of feature channels in the expansive path, which is what carries context from the contracting path up into the high-resolution layers and makes the architecture symmetric
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: batch size traded down to a single image so the input tile can be large, with the momentum raised to 0.99 so that the update still integrates many previously seen samples
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: initial weights drawn so that each feature map starts at approximately unit variance, which is what stops one path through the network from saturating while another never contributes
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Because convolutions are unpadded, border pixels are lost at every layer and feature maps must be cropped before concatenation.
span.note: what this limits: every output map's extent relative to its input: THE CROPPING IS NECESSARY DUE TO THE LOSS OF BORDER PIXELS IN EVERY CONVOLUTION
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Without the overlap-tile strategy the resolution the network can handle is bounded by GPU memory.
span.note: what this limits: application to large images: THIS TILING STRATEGY IS IMPORTANT ... SINCE OTHERWISE THE RESOLUTION WOULD BE LIMITED BY THE GPU MEMORY
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Part of what the network is trained to detect is inserted by the authors: the separation borders between touching cells are synthesised, not annotated.
span.note: what this limits: a comparison of this network's boundary accuracy against a method trained on unmodified ground truth: the separation borders between touching cells are introduced by the authors and computed with morphological operations, so the two are trained on different targets
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: How heavily those borders count is set by two chosen constants in the loss.
span.note: what this limits: the segmentation scores reported here: the pixel-wise loss weight that forces border learning is controlled by two values the authors chose, w0 = 10 and a sigma of about 5 pixels
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The invariances the network has are the ones the augmentation supplied, and the paper says the corpus never contained them.
span.note: what this limits: a claim that this network is robust to deformation: the invariance was taught by applying elastic deformations during training, and the paper states the annotated corpus did not need to contain those transformations at all
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
